name: tasks

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.federation.config.mjs

_comment-dependencies: This split is NOT the usual runtime-vs-tooling one, and moving a package across it changes
what the browser runs. @jahia/vite-federation-plugin turns every key of "dependencies" into
a module-federation SHARE (see vite.federation.config.mjs), i.e. a package the app shell is
expected to hand us at runtime; everything else is bundled privately. Every package here is
bundled into dist/ by the SSR/islands build either way, so "dependencies" here means
"provided by the app shell", not "needed at runtime".
@jahia/moonstone and @jahia/moonstone-alpha therefore sit in devDependencies on purpose: the
shell only publishes Moonstone 2.14.2, which exports neither Banner, DataTable nor EmptyData,
so the board cannot use the shell's copy and must bundle its own -- privately, see the crash
described in the fix commit for #61.
